notes.title: Rarity Overhaul Patch (v1.3.2)
notes.notes:
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc7KURGUdWK3FRGeA7EBFDY8ZHaFDsihCTRZ2vCvoFGKwBFmDUTwqXPt5wOmJr5czpSPpLL6j38l8oXTbYC14eHywoygc6d0Wp1pMTC02V38vgovDhCPlEOVJ6WpTE2WhP-IFwo?key=GEcuTo0FZvzFgSGvA0KZTw"]

Today’s patch focuses on all things organ rarities, starting with a nice visual bar to display how likely each rarity is. As you upgrade your shop and unlock more rare organs this bar will update to reflect the likelihoods.



In addition to this the rarity scaling has been completely reworked. It should still feel very familiar, but now scales all the way until epic is a 100% chance (yes, this is now technically possible!)


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcuS_5_J5DJCcfJscdQFChwP-bouH7CZovCDgjZ3t0VKP-BIl3_Z4q4AobY_d16bMD4LbuwFXgEfVRr7WD0gRTBG5t_I9hlJvRwrLz8X_bTQ39M_p9ZnkGGHWz6Ho7w-4hgu4CGXQ?key=GEcuTo0FZvzFgSGvA0KZTw"][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcdJNep3CAoQCBoxUlv1Gnz0Qw2qFvAmKElCw6QD75L_Ng0V-JnnTw9s1gykdxsz8Vlgyp7IeNoMFehK5iS5p_JJwD0AS8YkmA5RqBhy329EaW9RcwZgFPP53oJozPyiGaubV3gJw?key=GEcuTo0FZvzFgSGvA0KZTw"]

At the risk of overwhelming here is a complete breakdown of the differences between the old and new chances. Note that most changes are within a few percentage points so generally you shouldn’t notice much. But what of the new scaling? It’s right here:

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfaMnk2ejcltNxHT4urnuLAdM1N1lRISBP6i6NuzOfVi_R0o7K4k8IIyZ1_wsuMzCFNpTsvtX1QYV3X5HwWXFxRTWcnVFC-JeSWVFtGqg41KV9xplcJuIsEyDDq_oxdqcz8gJM6uw?key=GEcuTo0FZvzFgSGvA0KZTw"]

After your rarity passes the old maximum, every rarity will now slowly taper off until only epic organs will spawn. This new chart can be reached both through existing events and relics (the shovel is now good again) and several new events being added to this patch that should help you race towards the bottom.

notes.title: Inventory Sorting Patch (v1.3.1)
notes.notes:
Inventory Sorting Patch (v1.3.1)

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdWz3YYfMOii2x5uqAaNSG6gLmdgHZfBWpnqKEg6Jmr6j1vk7D7AqZd8AGR8MMN4d0DkZIpEWTJeMReTzclo0VmfL9smdNijEfMmlNjdB2KjCls_Y_-IPDlVje5px4tf2QoaOa9?key=MF2MFFbvuW8RsTfQ3uMDcQ"]

This patch adds sorting buttons to the worker screen, saving many clicks! Min-maxers be warned: it does not auto-assign workers to the slot that gives the most. Rather than completely removing the worker assignment minigame clicking the button will sort your workers by that job type, then blindly assign workers starting from the back to the front. This always puts your best zombie at the last slot of the job which may not always be the best one…




Full Changelog

Added one more slot to player worker inventory to reflect the maximum number of zombies (13)

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a crash that could happen if you continued a save that left off in the work screen

Fixed a crash that could happen if you rolled an event that does not exist

notes.title: Patch 1.2.3 ( Gameplay and UI updates + new Chinese localization in progress )
notes.notes:
Announcements

A professional localization of simplified Chinese and traditional Chinese is currently being worked on. I expect this to be ready and in game within two weeks.

General Updates

In order to reduce confusion for new players, you will have to unlock the extra necromancers by defeating ritual levels 0,1,2 respectively.

Switched out the proceed button with a collect all button. You will now automatically collect all resources from battle by pressing this button. You can still click on individual items for that fun feedback.

In order to reduce confusion for new players, the witch’s house will be closed until day 2, the blacksmith will be closed until day 3, and the demonologist will be closed until day 4.

UI Updates

Battle rewards now shimmy and shake a little - hopefully looking more clickable.

When you hover over the primary stats on your zombies in the workshop, it will highlight the secondary combat effect of that stat.

The tooltip for the primary stat now displays left instead of right. It was covering up the secondary combat stats.

The tooltip for displaying combat information in the battle scene is now locked to the top right of the screen.

Help button is disabled battle scene.

Balance Updates

Cursed mask no longer has the downside of giving all your zombies 0 dex during combat.

Bug fixes

Fixed an issue where the translation wouldn't update in the meta progression panel.

notes.title: Praise Dead - Major Update v 1.1 - Meta progression is here!
notes.notes:
Praise Dead - Major Update v 1.1

Meta-progression

Hello everyone! In this major update I have added 25 new meta-progression upgrades that will greatly change the way your zombies do battle. These upgrades start off as simple stat improvements and can work their way up to exploding critical strikes that do damage to the entire field. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447978/58663a3d554f150ebda9db0f2022444c798dce89.png

Each upgrade can be taken at least once, but many can have multiple points you can allocate into them. 

Upgrades also have tiers which indicate their power level. For a rank 10 upgrade you will first need to allocate 10 meta-progression points before they become available. These points can be divided however you choose.

New Necromancer

In addition to the meta-progression system, I have also added a new necromancer that relies on dealing damage by taking damage. Necromancer Springstep is equipped with a new boss relic, Prickles the Hedgehog. This hedgehog gives all zombies +8 spike damage, making them very painful to attack. Springstep also has the wooden shield as their minor relic which prevents 4 incoming damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44447978/be3fe582827acb90df3a222097b23a85f7d1f743.png

I believe this necromancer will help unlock a more passive approach to defeating the game, where your zombies try to mitigate as much damage as possible, and allow the monsters to remove themselves from the battle.

That's all for now but expect more free content and updates in the near future. Please check out the full patch notes below.
 

Patch Notes

New


 Meta progression with 25 unique upgrades to empower your zombies. These will radically improve the power and play style of your zombies.
 Boss Relic - Prickles the Hedgehog - All zombies gain +8 Spike Damage.
 Relic – Vault - Zombies gain an additional +1 health for every 35 gold.
 Relic - Travelers Cloak - Grants zombies 10% added dodge.
 Necromancer – Springstep – Starts with Prickles the Hedgehog and Wooden shield.
 Church and blacksmith now have upgrade sound effects.
 Church and blacksmith now have refresh sound effects.
 Locking parts in the church now has a sound effect.
 Event selection now has a sound effect.


Updates


 Reduced volume on Pained Thoughts death sound.
 Updated various graphics on panels around the game.


Balance Updates


 Reduced the effectiveness of luck for critical strikes. This affects both demons and zombies equally. Demons will now crit less often and so will the player.
